utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’m still in for Saturday at your front porch for the repair drive. I’ll check the time and get back to you so we can line up the helpers.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, just send me the time when you have it and I’ll line up the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia. Quick update: the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch, so please help me pass that along.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Got it — I’ll pass along the Sunday community center change and update the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, Oren — just send me the time and I’ll spread the word. We’ll make sure the repair drive has plenty of hands on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess — I’ll check the time and get back to you soon so you can spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll bring the tools I’ve got and be there Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Saturday at the front porch works. See you at 9 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be there Saturday at the front porch. Just let me know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Uli. I’m still checking the time with Mina, and I’ll let you know what to bring as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Got it, Rosa. Send me the time and I’ll pass it along to the neighbors for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll send the time as soon as it’s confirmed, Tess, and thanks for helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: 9 a.m. at the front porch works best for me. Can you make it then?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, 9 a.m. at the front porch works for me. I’ll keep the timing locked in and make sure the rest lines up.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
